articles.summary: Having a TFSA, RRSP and taxable investment account can make investing feel more complicated than it needs to be. You might wonder what should go in each account, whether they should all hold the same investments, or which account you should add money to next. A simpler place to start is with one question: What are you using the money for?
articles.title: How to manage a TFSA, RRSP and taxable account together in Canada
